paragraphs.text: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
paragraphs.original: Βίβλος γενέσεως Ἰησοῦ χριστοῦ υἱοῦ Δαυὶδ υἱοῦ Ἀβραάμ.
paragraphs.translit: Biblos geneseōs Iēsou christou hyiou Dauid hyiou Abraam.

paragraphs.text: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;
paragraphs.original: Ἀβραὰμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαάκ, Ἰσαὰκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ, Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Abraam egennēsen ton Isaak, Isaak de egennēsen ton Iakōb, Iakōb de egennēsen ton Ioudan kai tous adelphous autou,

paragraphs.text: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;
paragraphs.original: Ἰούδας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φαρὲς καὶ τὸν Ζάρα ἐκ τῆς Θαμάρ, Φαρὲς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑσρώμ, Ἑσρὼμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀράμ,
paragraphs.translit: Ioudas de egennēsen ton Phares kai ton Zara ek tēs Thamar, Phares de egennēsen ton Hesrōm, Hesrōm de egennēsen ton Aram,

paragraphs.text: and Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;
paragraphs.original: Ἀρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμιναδάβ, Ἀμιναδὰβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναασσών, Ναασσὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλμών,
paragraphs.translit: Aram de egennēsen ton Aminadab, Aminadab de egennēsen ton Naassōn, Naassōn de egennēsen ton Salmōn,

paragraphs.text: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
paragraphs.original: Σαλμὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βόες ἐκ τῆς Ῥαχάβ, Βόες δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωβὴδ ἐκ τῆς Ῥούθ, Ἰωβὴδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεσσαί,
paragraphs.translit: Salmōn de egennēsen ton Boes ek tēs Rhachab, Boes de egennēsen ton Iōbēd ek tēs Rhouth, Iōbēd de egennēsen ton Iessai,

paragraphs.text: and Jesse begat David the king.     And David begat Solomon of her [that had been the wife] of Uriah;
paragraphs.original: Ἰεσσαὶ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Δαυὶδ τὸν βασιλέα. Δαυὶδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σολομῶνα ἐκ τῆς τοῦ Οὐρίου,
paragraphs.translit: Iessai de egennēsen ton Dauid ton basilea. Dauid de egennēsen ton Solomōna ek tēs tou Ouriou,

paragraphs.text: and Solomon begat Rehoboam; and Rehoboam begat Abijah; and Abijah begat Asa;
paragraphs.original: Σολομὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ῥοβοάμ, Ῥοβοὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιά, Ἀβιὰ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀσάφ,
paragraphs.translit: Solomōn de egennēsen ton Rhoboam, Rhoboam de egennēsen ton Abia, Abia de egennēsen ton Asaph,

paragraphs.text: and Asa begat Jehoshaphat; and Jehoshaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Uzziah;
paragraphs.original: Ἀσὰφ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσαφάτ, Ἰωσαφὰτ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωράμ, Ἰωρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ὀζίαν,
paragraphs.translit: Asaph de egennēsen ton Iōsaphat, Iōsaphat de egennēsen ton Iōram, Iōram de egennēsen ton Ozian,

paragraphs.text: and Uzziah begat Jotham; and Jotham begat Ahaz; and Ahaz begat Hezekiah;
paragraphs.original: Ὀζίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωαθάμ, Ἰωαθὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχάζ, Ἀχὰζ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑζεκίαν,
paragraphs.translit: Ozias de egennēsen ton Iōatham, Iōatham de egennēsen ton Achaz, Achaz de egennēsen ton Hezekian,

paragraphs.text: and Hezekiah begat Manasseh; and Manasseh begat Amon; and Amon begat Josiah;
paragraphs.original: Ἑζεκίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μανασσῆ, Μανασσῆς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμώς, Ἀμὼς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσίαν,
paragraphs.translit: Hezekias de egennēsen ton Manassē, Manassēs de egennēsen ton Amōs, Amōs de egennēsen ton Iōsian,

paragraphs.text: and Josiah begat Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.
paragraphs.original: Ἰωσίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεχονίαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος.
paragraphs.translit: Iōsias de egennēsen ton Iechonian kai tous adelphous autou epi tēs metoikesias Babylōnos.

paragraphs.text: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jechoniah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;
paragraphs.original: Μετὰ δὲ τὴν μετοικεσίαν Βαβυλῶνος Ἰεχονίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλαθιήλ, Σαλαθιὴλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ζοροβαβέλ,
paragraphs.translit: Meta de tēn metoikesian Babylōnos Iechonias egennēsen ton Salathiēl, Salathiēl de egennēsen ton Zorobabel,

paragraphs.text: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
paragraphs.original: Ζοροβαβὲλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιούδ, Ἀβιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιακίμ, Ἐλιακὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζώρ,
paragraphs.translit: Zorobabel de egennēsen ton Abioud, Abioud de egennēsen ton Eliakim, Eliakim de egennēsen ton Azōr,

paragraphs.text: and Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
paragraphs.original: Ἀζὼρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ, Σαδὼκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχίμ, Ἀχὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιούδ,
paragraphs.translit: Azōr de egennēsen ton Sadōk, Sadōk de egennēsen ton Achim, Achim de egennēsen ton Elioud,

paragraphs.text: and Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
paragraphs.original: Ἐλιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλεάζαρ, Ἐλεάζαρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ματθάν, Ματθὰν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ,
paragraphs.translit: Elioud de egennēsen ton Eleazar, Eleazar de egennēsen ton Matthan, Matthan de egennēsen ton Iakōb,

paragraphs.text: and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
paragraphs.original: Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἄνδρα Μαρίας, ἐξ ἧς ἐγεννήθη Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος χριστός.
paragraphs.translit: Iakōb de egennēsen ton Iōsēph ton andra Marias, ex hēs egennēthē Iēsous ho legomenos christos.

paragraphs.text: So all the generations from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations; and from David unto the carrying away to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon unto the Christ fourteen generations.
paragraphs.original: Πᾶσαι οὖν αἱ γενεαὶ ἀπὸ Ἀβραὰμ ἕως Δαυὶδ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ Δαυὶδ ἕως τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος ἕως τοῦ χριστοῦ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες.
paragraphs.translit: Pasai oun hai geneai apo Abraam heōs Dauid geneai dekatessares, kai apo Dauid heōs tēs metoikesias Babylōnos geneai dekatessares, kai apo tēs metoikesias Babylōnos heōs tou christou geneai dekatessares.

paragraphs.text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ χριστοῦ ἡ γένεσις οὕτως ἦν. μνηστευθείσης τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Μαρίας τῷ Ἰωσήφ, πρὶν ἢ συνελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εὑρέθη ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσα ἐκ πνεύματος ἁγίου.
paragraphs.translit: Tou de Iēsou christou hē genesis houtōs ēn. mnēsteutheisēs tēs mētros autou Marias tō Iōsēph, prin ē synelthein autous heurethē en gastri echousa ek pneumatos hagiou.

paragraphs.text: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.
paragraphs.original: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς, δίκαιος ὢν καὶ μὴ θέλων αὐτὴν δειγματίσαι, ἐβουλήθη λάθρᾳ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν.
paragraphs.translit: Iōsēph de ho anēr autēs, dikaios ōn kai mē thelōn autēn deigmatisai, eboulēthē lathra apolysai autēn.

paragraphs.text: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐνθυμηθέντος ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου κατʼ ὄναρ ἐφάνη αὐτῷ λέγων· Ἰωσὴφ υἱὸς Δαυίδ, μὴ φοβηθῇς παραλαβεῖν Μαρίαν τὴν γυναῖκά σου, τὸ γὰρ ἐν αὐτῇ γεννηθὲν ἐκ πνεύματός ἐστιν ἁγίου·
paragraphs.translit: tauta de autou enthymēthentos idou angelos kyriou katʼ onar ephanē autō legōn· Iōsēph hyios Dauid, mē phobēthēs paralabein Marian tēn gynaika sou, to gar en autē gennēthen ek pneumatos estin hagiou·

paragraphs.text: And she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name JESUS; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.
paragraphs.original: τέξεται δὲ υἱὸν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν, αὐτὸς γὰρ σώσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: texetai de hyion kai kaleseis to onoma autou Iēsoun, autos gar sōsei ton laon autou apo tōn hamartiōn autōn.

paragraphs.text: Now all this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·
paragraphs.translit: touto de holon gegonen hina plērōthē to rhēthen hypo kyriou dia tou prophētou legontos·

paragraphs.text: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring       forth a son, And they shall call his name Immanuel;     which is, being interpreted, God with us.
paragraphs.original: Ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ καλέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐμμανουήλ· ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Μεθʼ ἡμῶν ὁ θεός.
paragraphs.translit: Idou hē parthenos en gastri hexei kai texetai hyion, kai kalesousin to onoma autou Emmanouēl· ho estin methermēneuomenon Methʼ hēmōn ho theos.

paragraphs.text: And Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;
paragraphs.original: ἐγερθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου ἐποίησεν ὡς προσέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ παρέλαβεν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: egertheis de ho Iōsēph apo tou hypnou epoiēsen hōs prosetaxen autō ho angelos kyriou kai parelaben tēn gynaika autou·

paragraphs.text: and knew her not till she had brought forth a son: and he called his name JESUS.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν αὐτὴν ἕως οὗ ἔτεκεν υἱόν· καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.
paragraphs.translit: kai ouk eginōsken autēn heōs hou eteken hyion· kai ekalesen to onoma autou Iēsoun.
